help.title: About Payments
help.overview: Payments lists every installment and down payment of every payment-plan sale, by date, so you can see what is late and what is coming without opening each sale. The rows are the same records as the Payment Plan tab of a sale; this page only gathers them.

sections.title: What you get
items: The tiles answer “how much is waiting”: overdue, due in 7 days, due in 30 days, collected this month.
Group by day, week or month to total the coming period; click a period to narrow the list to it.
The calendar marks each day with a dot per status and totals the day you pick.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Status comes from the dates, so a payment is overdue the day after it was due, whatever the last nightly run recorded.
Totals are kept per currency and are never converted.
Opening a row opens its payment plan, where you record the payment as usual.

sections.title: When to use the sale instead
items: Overview → Payment plan sale still holds the full plan: schedule, restructuring, receipts and emails.
